why: The check disc takes pointer events. It overhangs the chosen control's corner by 8px, into the gap and onto a neighbour, so a press on that neighbour's corner lands on the chosen control's pseudo-element and selects the wrong thing -- and a hover there shows on the wrong control. Issue #630's approved treatment reserves nothing and must change no hit target.
killedBy: hud.css: the selected check (issue #630) is a real layer that takes no pointer, with the check cut from a mask
